Subject: Re: Vendor invite accepted but Can’t see PO — MFA/consent hang

On 2026-10-18 09:12, Samir Patel wrote:
> We accepted the supplier portal invite this morning but our account still shows ‘No purchase orders found’. When we try to complete the MFA/consent step it spins and then returns an error: “Consent flow failed — redirect loop”.

Thanks for the details — looked into RID hf-7721. Quick summary of findings:
- The initial invite token was valid and the SAML assertion reached Redwood, but the relayState returned with a query parameter we do not recognize (relayState=rs%3Dlegacy-claim). That triggered our legacy-compat fallback which then attempted a cross-origin cookie write that fails in modern SameSite contexts.
- The redirect_count shows a loop: 6 redirects between /saml/consent -> /auth/accept -> /saml/consent (stuck).

Short-term workaround: we regenerated a fresh invite token and disabled the legacy-compat redirect for that token only. Samir, I sent a new invite to ops@helmforge.com just now — please accept it from an incognito/private window (important) and do NOT click any previously bookmarked portal links.

Medium-term fix (in ticket): engineering will add stricter relayState validation and update the consent endpoint to avoid cross-origin cookie writes when SameSite=Strict is detected. ETA for patch: 48–72 hours. I created internal ticket RED-INF-3421.

Follow-up actions I took:
- Forced reissue of invite token for HF-9987 (new token id: it-20261018-409).
- Logged a rollback plan in case the patch causes edgecases for older clients.

If the new invite fails, please escalate to support@redwood.ai and include RID hf-7721 and it-20261018-409.

—Ben Carter
Platform Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Priyom / Ben / Laura — quick status update from our side: the new invite worked. We accepted from an incognito window and completed the consent step; PO list populated after a ~30s sync. Confirmed by our AP team — invoice mapping visible now.

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear workaround. Please keep me posted when RED-INF-3421 is live so we can coordinate with our IT (some customers still have bookmarked links that could hit legacy relayState).

Samir
